notes.title: 0.4.1.1 hotfix
notes.notes:
Just a few fixes from yesterday's release

 auto-moving items to the upgrade interface can no longer accidentally delete items
 when unequipping an equipment piece that has a weapon, any modifiers attached to that modifier are now automatically moved back to the inventory. no more losing track of or accidentally deleting weapon modifiers
deactivating a set bonus attack automatically moves any equipped weapon mods back to inventory
removed infinitely rerolling. you now correctly get 1 free reroll per level.

notes.title: Upcoming Price Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Elmok here. While the next update for RuneLight isn't quite ready yet, I have an important announcement on the future. In (just under) 2 weeks, on October 18,2024, RuneLight will be going from 5 USD to 10 USD. This is to go along with major update 0.4, which will release the following week on October 25, 2024

Why?
When I first priced RuneLight, I was planning a much smaller scoped and simple game. However, that original vision wasn't shaping up to be a fun game, so a little over a year ago I decided to majorly rescope, expand on, and rework RuneLight. I have put a lot more work into making the game better, and I believe it is fair to increase the price to reflect the larger scope and effort going into it

Why now?
The price is increasing to go along with the 0.4 update, which is an important benchmark. As of 0.4, I consider RuneLight to be feature complete  in regards to the core mechanics. Other than a few smaller features like proper boss fights and additional primary weapons, the gameplay of 0.4 is the same gameplay you can expect from the full release

Will RuneLight increase in price again?
No. At some point you have to decide where to draw the line in the sand and define what will and will not make it into the game, and over the past couple weeks I've been really ironing out what will and will not make it into 1.0 and what price I believe to be fair for the content RuneLight offers.

As such, any future expansions to the game's scope will come as either free post 1.0 updates or potentially paid dlc, but the base game of RuneLight will always be 10USD

What happens next?
within the next week I will be releasing a detailed roadmap and video laying out exactly what my plans are so you can know exactly what to expect going forwards. A week later, the price will go up from 5USD to 10USD, as well as teasers for 0.4, an update to the trailer and promotional material. The following week 0.4 will come out

notes.title: RuneLight Update Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hello everybody! Elmok here. Things have been a bit quiet, but I'm hard at work on the first major update for RuneLight. Unfortunately this update will probably take multiple weeks if not months to fully deliver on, so I created this visual roadmap to track my progress in the meantime!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44116119/55f8db0857ed60e1ac970b5756f10284e885ad00.png

Let's break down exactly what the roadmap means:

Weapons:obviously, I have deemed this update the weapons update. I believe Runelight does not have enough weapons and weapon variations to keep the game interesting for extended periods of time, and I'd like to spend the first major update correcting this issue. I plan to go from the game's current 8 weapons to 24. Each of the small squares represents 1 weapon with 2 evolutions.

Resprites:I'm not happy with most of RuneLight's current art and visuals. I wouldn't go as far as to say it's bad, but I will say it is boring, basic, uninspired. Over the next few updates I plan to rework pretty much every aspect of the game's visuals, starting with the player. I have provided a sketch of the player's design as well as marked the animations the player will need. 

Enemies: I'm not happy with the current map system. I think it's basic and boring, and I have plans for a completely reworked and more interesting system. While I won't be reworking the maps as a whole this update, I will be adding a full cast of new enemies to the Forest map.

Other Tasks:I have also added a space for miscellaneous tasks and things that will need to get down before I can fully release the update. This is not a currently exhaustive list and I will be adding to it as development continues and I get a more clear idea of what's missing.

To end off, here's where the roadmap stands after the first week of active development:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44116119/8c3d2cbb711493b6c2c7a193f06e91f18c67a009.png

Going Forward, I plan to post weekly roadmap updates on my Twitter and Discord, so Follow me there if you wish to see more consistent updates. 

Twitter: https://twitter.com/Elhmok_yt

Discord: https://discord.gg/NdwfnNutqA
